hebrew_text: "...כדי לגלות את נשק המגן תצטרכו לחרוש את כל אדמות ארץ ישראל" (פרופ' חיים ויצמן)
english_translation: "...to find the defence weapons you would have to plough every acre of the Land of Israel" (Prof. Chaim Weizmann)
subject: Opening quotation panel of the exhibition
notes: Attributed on the board to Weizmann; wording not yet traced to a published source.

hebrew_text: "מעשה רוחמה ודורות – התגרות" / שביתת חירום בעיתונים המצולמים – מעשי ההרס בשני הישובים נמשכים
english_translation: "The Ruhama and Dorot affair - a provocation" / the destruction in both settlements continues
subject: Hebrew press headline strip
notes: Sub-headline partly illegible at this resolution.

hebrew_text: 3 יחידות צבא אנגליה – הדיביזיה השישית המוטסת, המכונה בארץ "הכלניות" – שהשתתפו במצור על הקיבוץ. [68 | 941 | 67]
english_translation: Three British Army units - the 6th Airborne Division, known locally as "the Anemones" - took part in the siege of the kibbutz. [unit numbers 68, 941, 67]
subject: Order of battle panel with three unit insignia drawn as triangles
notes: "Anemones" = red berets. The three numbers are drawn inside triangular formation signs.

hebrew_text: חיל כבד שם מצור על המשקים רוחמה ודורות / רשמית: הפעולות מכוונות לחיפוש נשק
english_translation: Heavy force lays siege to the farms Ruhama and Dorot / Officially: the operations are aimed at searching for arms
subject: Front-page headline

hebrew_text: גזרי עיתונים: "משמר" / "דבר" / "הדאר" (?) + כרטיס: רדיו ירושלים, 28.8.1946 + "הדים: ...רוחמה ודורות בנגב השומם נשלט בידי צבא בריטי מצויד בנשק רב – משוריינים, מוקשים וכו'"
english_translation: Newspaper clippings plus a card citing Radio Jerusalem, 28.8.1946, and an "Echoes" card: "...Ruhama and Dorot in the desolate Negev are controlled by a British army equipped with heavy weapons - armour, mines and so on"
subject: Cluster of press clippings on the board
notes: KEY DATE EVIDENCE: the Radio Jerusalem card is dated 28.8.1946. Masthead identifications are provisional.

hebrew_text: רוחמה במצור
english_translation: Ruhama Under Siege
subject: Exhibition title board (detail)

hebrew_text: אנחנו: "...למה הרסתם תנור האפיה? האין יודעים הקצינים כי אי אפשר להסתיר נשק בתנור מוסק?"
english_translation: Us: "...why did you destroy the baking oven? Do the officers not know that you cannot hide weapons in a lit oven?"
subject: Voice-of-the-members caption card
notes: One of a series of blue cards giving the kibbutz members' own reactions.

subject: Wrecked interior: torn bedding and papers, broken furniture, roof beams pulled down

hebrew_text: ...מה ודורות – התגרות" / ...צומתם. – מעשי ההרס בשני הישובים נמשכים
english_translation: "...[Ruha]ma and Dorot - a provocation" / the destruction in both settlements continues
subject: Headline strip (same story as #2)

hebrew_text: "החפושים – הזמנה להרוס את רוחמה בפעם השלישית" / מרת גולדה מאירסון במסיבה עם עתונאי־חוץ
english_translation: "The searches - an invitation to destroy Ruhama for the third time" / Mrs Golda Meyerson at a press conference with foreign journalists
subject: Report of a Jewish Agency press conference
notes: Golda Meyerson (later Meir) was acting head of the Jewish Agency political department after the Black Saturday arrests. Strong, checkable anchor.

subject: Overturned wooden bed frame / cupboard in a ransacked room
Outdoor structure levered off its foundations; the ground dug out beneath it
notes: One of the clearest prints in the set.

subject: Floor and brick wall broken open, rubble heaped below a standing beam
notes: Matches the accounts of floors being smashed and trenches dug along the walls.

subject: Wrecked machinery / stove beside a corrugated wall
notes: Orientation inferred, not certain.

hebrew_text: "משק צעיר, בן שנתיים בנגב נהרס תוך שעות..." / "עמל שנים נהרס תוך שעות" – פניה בה מתארגנת החקלאית הבינלאומית (תל־אביב)
english_translation: "A young farm, two years old in the Negev, destroyed within hours..." / "Years of labour destroyed within hours" - an appeal to the international agricultural body
subject: Caption card plus clipping about the appeal to international agricultural organisations
notes: Body text partly legible; mentions a 5-day operation and c. 2,000 soldiers.

subject: Storeroom or workshop with contents strewn across the floor

hebrew_text: רוחמה במצור / חיפוש נשק תש"ו-1946
english_translation: Ruhama Under Siege / Weapons Search 5706-1946
subject: Exhibition title board
notes: The Hebrew year on the board reads תש"ו (5706). Late August 1946 falls in Elul 5706.

subject: Concrete floor broken up; graffiti chalked on the surface
notes: Orientation inferred. A heart and Latin letters are visible.

subject: Interior with windows, furniture overturned, bedding and paper across the floor
Dark interior / doorway of a damaged building
notes: Print is under-exposed; orientation inferred.

subject: Room stripped bare, mattresses slit open, table and chairs upturned

hebrew_text: [חלקי] ...שלושה ואחרים... [כרטיס כחול]
english_translation: [partial] blue caption card, text cut off in the photograph
subject: Caption card, partly out of frame
notes: Needs rephotographing.

subject: Exterior of a kibbutz building with the ground dug up along its wall
notes: Orientation inferred.

hebrew_text: צריף הקומונה ותכולתה הושחתה. ערימת בגדים מזוהמים, מכונות התפירה, ציוד, כלים, נוצות, חיתולי ילדים – הרכוש המועט שהיה לנו אינו יותר לשימוש.
english_translation: The commune hut and its contents were ruined. A heap of soiled clothes, the sewing machines, equipment, utensils, feathers, babies' nappies - the little property we had is no longer usable.
subject: Caption card, members' account of the commune hut
notes: One of the most quotable lines on the whole board.

hebrew_text: המעש (בטאון לח"י): "מפאריס-לונדון עד רוחמה"
english_translation: HaMa'as (organ of Lehi): "From Paris-London to Ruhama"
subject: Underground press clipping
notes: Shows the search was also used politically by the Revisionist underground.

subject: Slit mattresses and scattered bedding in a dark interior

hebrew_text: שלט: "התבואה תבוא / ...מיד אחת נפתח באש" + כיתוב בערבית
english_translation: Sign (partly legible) with Arabic text below; a young woman stands beside it
subject: A woman beside a British warning sign posted at the settlement
notes: The most human, most publishable image in the set. Sign text needs a clean scan; the Arabic line is a warning to open fire.

subject: A member carrying a slit mattress out of a wrecked room

hebrew_text: YEHUDI SWINE
english_translation: YEHUDI SWINE
subject: Antisemitic graffiti chalked on a blackboard by searching soldiers
notes: Documentary evidence of the conduct of the search; use with an explanatory caption, never as a standalone shock image.

hebrew_text: ...תקו החיים בקיבוץ... בחדר האוכל... [מט]בח הרוס, הצי[וד]... "ברנר" נעקר מה[מקום]
english_translation: [partial] "...life in the kibbutz was cut off... in the dining hall... the kitchen destroyed, the equipment... the 'Brener' [burner/pump] torn out"
subject: Caption card on the dining hall and kitchen
notes: Text runs off the edge of the photograph.

subject: A heavy beam or lintel thrown down across dug-up ground

hebrew_text: משמר: "הרס והתעללות ביישובים הנצורים – יום חמישי למצור ולחיפושים ברוחמה ודורות" / הקצין וילסון: "רוחמה, מרכז נשק הגדול אחרי יגור"
english_translation: Mishmar: "Destruction and abuse in the besieged settlements - fifth day of the siege and searches at Ruhama and Dorot" / Officer Wilson: "Ruhama, the largest arms centre after Yagur"
subject: Mishmar front page, day five of the siege
notes: CRITICAL: dates the siege to at least five days and names the British officer. Mishmar was the Hashomer Hatzair daily, later Al HaMishmar.

subject: Trench dug along a building line, debris and timber piled in it
notes: Orientation inferred.

subject: A woman at a table in a wrecked kitchen or dining hall, salvaging utensils
notes: Strong human-scale image; good series opener or closer.

subject: Store shelves emptied, linen and bedding thrown into a heap
A mattress cut open, its stuffing pulled out - the standard search technique
Dark interior, floor broken open near a window

hebrew_text: משמר: "הרס והתעללות ביישובים הנצורים – יום חמישי למצור ולחיפושים ברוחמה ודורות. חמסו מבארות בריחות, מחסני אספקה ובמים, ובכל משק רכוש הועלה באש – גילו נשק מגן – החיפושים נמשכים" / הקצין וילסון: "רוחמה, מרכז נשק הגדול אחרי יגור"
english_translation: Mishmar: "Destruction and abuse in the besieged settlements - fifth day of the siege and searches at Ruhama and Dorot" / Officer Wilson: "Ruhama, the largest arms centre after Yagur"
subject: Mishmar front page (fuller frame of #32)
notes: Sub-deck transcription is provisional - needs a flatbed scan.

subject: Long interior, probably the cowshed or a barn, wrecked along its whole length
notes: Orientation inferred.

hebrew_text: ...מתבנים הועלו באש. האספקה... בעלי חיים עורבבו... זבל כימי... הגרעינים טופ[לו]
english_translation: [partial] "...haystacks were set alight. The food stores... the livestock scattered... chemical fertiliser [mixed in]... the seed grain spoiled"
subject: Caption card on damage to the farm
notes: Card runs off the edge of the photograph; this is the agricultural-damage panel.

hebrew_text: משמר: "הרס והתעללות ביישובים הנצורים" / הקצין וילסון: "רוחמה, מרכז נשק הגדול אחרי יגור"
english_translation: Mishmar front page (third framing)
subject: Mishmar front page
notes: Duplicate framing of #32/#38 - useful for stitching a clean composite.

subject: A timber hut with its cladding torn off
notes: Orientation inferred.

subject: Open Negev landscape with a wrecked cart or implement
notes: Orientation inferred.

subject: Two prints mounted together: smashed office furniture and scattered ring-binders / files
notes: The lower frame shows the kibbutz office files thrown on the floor - the archive documenting its own ransacking.

subject: The yard: wrecked equipment, timber and machinery heaped after the search
notes: Widest, best-exposed print in the set. Natural hero image for the 16:9 page.

hebrew_text: "הנגב זועק תרגז ארץ!" מאת אליהו בוצני(?) / כותרת כחולה: "ענפי החקלאות נפגעו הראשונים" / "למה נבחרו דורות ורוחמה?"
english_translation: "The Negev cries out, let the country rage!" / blue card: "The farming branches were hit first" / "Why were Dorot and Ruhama chosen?"
subject: Opinion piece plus caption cards
notes: Author name uncertain at this resolution.

subject: A vast heap of smashed crockery - the kibbutz dining-hall dishes
notes: Visually the most arresting single frame. Orientation inferred.
